fill.about: Located in Greensboro, NC, Picante TCG is your one-stop shop for trading card games, singles, accessories, and tournaments. We provide a welcoming, inclusive space for players of all skill levels to connect, compete, and grow their passion for TCGs like Magic, Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and more.
